title: Six
desc: A gripping thriller that follows six strangers whose lives are intertwined by a dark mystery. As they uncover secrets, they realize they must confront their past to survive the present.

title: Teleshopping
desc: A satirical comedy exploring the world of infomercials and the power of persuasion. 'Teleshopping' humorously critiques consumerism while providing light-hearted entertainment.

title: Krishna Gaddi Veera Prema Gadha
desc: Krishna falls in love with Mahalakshmi, whose brother works for a don. Amid a gang war, the don entrusts Krishna with the responsibility of returning children to their parents.

title: Alludu Seenu
desc: Deep in debt, Seenu and uncle Narasimha flee to Chennai but end up in a city where Narasimha looks like a don.

title: Kathakali
desc: gripping action thriller that follows a man seeking revenge. The film combines intense action, emotional depth, and a tale of betrayal, justice, and resilience.

title: Kakki Sattai
desc: Police officer Mathimaran learns of an organ donation racket from his love Divya and uncovers shocking secrets.

title: Poojai
desc: Vasu, a moneylender, saves a policeman's life, unknowingly putting himself in the crosshairs of a dangerous gangster and contract killer.

title: Rajanna
desc: Mallamma, an orphan, loses her caretaker and her freedom to sing due to the jealousy of Dorasani, the village chief. Her music teacher shares the inspiring story of Rajanna to uplift her spirit.

title: Nagesh Thiraiyarangam
desc: An unsuccessful broker faces paranormal events while selling his ancestral theater for his sister's wedding. He discovers a malevolent spirit is using him to commit murders.
